hero.heading2: I build things for the web.
hero.paragraph: Full Stack Developer specializing in building robust, scalable web applications. Currently focused on the MERN stack and crafting seamless digital experiences.

about.heading: About Me
about.p1: Hey! I'm Hassaan, a passionate Full Stack Developer with around 1 year of hands-on experience building web applications. I love turning ideas into real, functional products that people actually enjoy using.
about.p2: My journey started with curiosity about how websites work under the hood, which quickly evolved into building full-stack apps using the MERN stack. From crafting responsive frontends to designing RESTful APIs and managing databases — I enjoy every layer of the process.
about.p3: Here are a few technologies I've been working with recently:

descriptions.oneStopFrontend: An all‑in‑one frontend toolkit that demonstrates modern UI patterns and responsive layouts. It emphasises clean component architecture, modular styling, and accessibility best practices. The project was built with reusability in mind so new pages can be added with minimal effort.
descriptions.eventify: A full-stack event management platform allowing users to create, browse, register and manage events. The frontend offers a clean, responsive interface while the backend provides a secure REST API with authentication and data persistence. Built using a modern JavaScript stack, it handles real-time updates and scalable data storage.
descriptions.umrahrides: A transportation service tailored for pilgrims performing Umrah, simplifying the booking of rides and route planning. It features a user-friendly interface and real-time location tracking. The responsive design ensures it works well on both mobile and desktop, helping users coordinate travel during the pilgrimage.

contact.paragraph: I'm currently looking for new opportunities and my inbox is always open. Whether you have a question, a project idea, or just want to say hi — I'll do my best to get back to you!
